title: Convert an ICS file into a native event batch — docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md#t2
acceptance: Read the approved gates in docs/plans/ics-import/ and execute only packet T2 in docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md.
Outcome: Bounded valid ICS bytes become native event batches with preserved standalone, all-day, timed, recurrence-exclusion, and detached-override semantics.
Scope: new `backend/src/ics_import.rs`, `backend/src/lib.rs`, recurrence and parser-limit cases in `backend/tests/ics_import.rs`

Changes: Add `IcsImportService`, import constants, summary, and errors; invoke the existing parser with the 1,000-event policy; normalize status and timing; group components by UID; attach `EXDATE` and `RECURRENCE-ID` values; reject orphan, mismatched, conflicting, unknown-status, malformed, duplicate, and over-limit input before persistence; delegate once to `create_batch`; export the module.
Out of scope: HTTP body/media-type handling, route mounting, rate limiting, browser API or UI, changes to external-feed ingestion or the generic parser.

Acceptance: Timed and all-day standalone events import with correct fields; a recurring master stores deletions and replacements under the correct keys; every semantic or parser failure maps to the approved error category and leaves all persistence tables unchanged; re-import creates another editable native copy; summary counts top-level events separately from exceptions.
Handoff: Callable `IcsImportService::import`, stable summary/error contract, content-free failure categories, and tested constants for T3.
Record verification and completion in docs/plans/ics-import/00-status.md; preserve unrelated work.
